title: by the time / before / when 作参照

questions.stem: By the time he got home, his mother ____ (cook) dinner.

options.distractor: 做饭发生在他到家之前

questions.explanation: “他到家时”是参照点，做饭更早，用 had cooked。

questions.stem: They ____ (build) three bridges by the end of last year.

options.distractor: “到去年年底为止”要用过去完成时
last year 是过去参照点

questions.explanation: by the end of last year 是过去参照点，用 had built。

questions.stem: ____ the time the teacher came in, the students ____ (open) their books.

options.distractor: at the time 不是“到……为止”，且时态不对

questions.explanation: by the time + 过去时间，主句用 had opened。

questions.stem: He ____ (be) a worker for ten years before he became a driver.

options.distractor: “当工人”发生在“成为司机”之前

questions.explanation: before he became 是参照点，之前的状态用 had been。

options.text: By the time we arrived, he had left.
She had finished the letter before supper.
We have learned 300 words by the end of last month.
They had cleaned the classroom when the teacher came.

questions.explanation: last month 是过去参照点，应改为 had learned。

questions.stem: ____ we ____ (get) to the top, the sun ____ (rise).

options.text: By the time; got; had risen
By the time; had got; rose
options.distractor: 到达是参照点用过去时，日出更早
参照点是过去，不能用 has

questions.explanation: 到达山顶（got）是参照点，太阳升起更早，用 had risen。
